note: Plain-language concepts evidenced in mastery, Summit, or the puzzle architecture travel lists. Do not fill from general Earth Science memory.

concepts.name: Observation
concepts.summary: Distinguish what was actually observed from an interpretation.

concepts.name: Interpretation
concepts.summary: The story attached after notes exist. It can be wrong even when the observation is real.

concepts.name: Evidence
concepts.summary: Gather relevant observations and measurements that can support or weaken a claim.

concepts.name: Patterns
concepts.summary: Recognize meaningful patterns in data or the environment — not a one-off.

concepts.name: Variables
concepts.summary: Use measurements and recognize relationships among variables. A fair test changes one thing on purpose.

concepts.name: Fair test
concepts.summary: A fair test changes one thing, keeps the rest the same, and repeats the run.

concepts.name: Field data
concepts.summary: Interpret a graph, table, or field dataset.

concepts.name: Earth systems
concepts.summary: Link atmosphere, hydrosphere, and geosphere in one event — not by finishing two unrelated stories.

concepts.name: Explanation
concepts.summary: Construct an explanation supported by evidence.

concepts.name: Revision
concepts.summary: Revise a model or explanation when evidence conflicts with it. First-try success is not revision.

concepts.name: Communication
concepts.summary: Communicate a defensible conclusion.

concepts.name: Runoff
concepts.summary: Rainwater moving over the ground instead of soaking in right away.

concepts.name: Slope
concepts.summary: How steep the ground is. Water on a steeper slope usually gets where it is going sooner.

concepts.name: Gravity
concepts.summary: Gravity pulls water downhill. It does not pull water up Granite Knob.

concepts.name: Storage
concepts.summary: Storage holds water for a while. It can change timing without starting the flood.

concepts.name: Downstream
concepts.summary: The direction water already chose — toward lower ground.

concepts.name: Timescale
concepts.summary: How long a process needs. Last night is one clock. A mismatched boulder needs a longer one.

concepts.name: Cause
concepts.summary: What actually made the change. Being nearby is not enough.

concepts.name: Correlation
concepts.summary: Two things can happen together without one causing the other.

concepts.name: Location
concepts.summary: Use coordinates as a pair of values to establish where a place is.

concepts.name: Scale
concepts.summary: Use map scale to measure or compare distance on the land.

concepts.name: Elevation
concepts.summary: Read height above a datum and compare relief.

concepts.name: Contours
concepts.summary: Connect what the land looks like underfoot with contour spacing and shape.

concepts.name: Gradient
concepts.summary: Use elevation and distance to reason about steepness for a real travel problem.

concepts.name: Profile
concepts.summary: Translate a plan-view map into a side-view cross-section.

concepts.name: GIS layers
concepts.summary: Combine more than one spatial layer to answer a field question.

concepts.name: Remote sensing
concepts.summary: Use remotely sensed imagery with field and map evidence.

concepts.name: Geospatial decision
concepts.summary: Use geospatial evidence to choose and defend a route.

concepts.name: Spatial patterns
concepts.summary: Identify spatial relationships among terrain, water, trails, and features.

concepts.name: Map representation
concepts.summary: Notice that different representations of one place reveal different properties.

concepts.name: Earth rotation
concepts.summary: Explain apparent daily solar motion using Earth's rotation and recorded shadows.

concepts.name: Seasons
concepts.summary: Use tilt, Sun angle, and daylight — not Earth–Sun distance — to explain seasonal cycles.

concepts.name: Orbit shape
concepts.summary: Interpret elliptical geometry and changing speed with distance.

concepts.name: Mathematical orbit
concepts.summary: Use a simplified period–distance relation to predict a return and check it.

concepts.name: Moon phases
concepts.summary: Explain and predict phase from Earth–Moon–Sun geometry.

concepts.name: Eclipses
concepts.summary: Use orbital tilt to explain why eclipses do not happen every month.

concepts.name: Celestial data
concepts.summary: Interpret remote tide records and planetary tables without memorizing lists.

concepts.name: Observation planning
concepts.summary: Make and test a defensible observing plan, and revise it if the sky disagrees.

concepts.name: Sky model
concepts.summary: Use or revise an orbital model based on evidence.

concepts.name: Spectra as evidence
concepts.summary: Use spectral structure, not appearance, to compare sources.

concepts.name: Stellar temperature
concepts.summary: Rank temperature from peak/color evidence, not fire folklore.

concepts.name: Brightness vs distance
concepts.summary: Separate apparent brightness from distance using a walked baseline.

concepts.name: Diagram from measurements
concepts.summary: Place stars on unlabeled axes from player measurements.

concepts.name: Stellar lives and mass
concepts.summary: Show that initial mass branches stellar futures.

concepts.name: Origin of some elements
concepts.summary: Connect basin rock and metal lines without claiming all elements were made in stars.

concepts.name: Redshift as shifted lines
concepts.summary: Treat redshift as a shifted line pattern, not a red color.

concepts.name: Converging origin evidence
concepts.summary: Assemble expansion, leftover glow, and abundance rather than a slogan.

concepts.name: Lookback time
concepts.summary: Refuse present-tense claims for distant light.

concepts.name: Bounded claims
concepts.summary: Separate observed, inferred, unknown, and refused overclaims.

concepts.name: Rain shadow
concepts.summary: A mountain barrier lifts moist air on the windward side and leaves drier country to leeward.

concepts.name: Mineral identification
concepts.summary: Identify minerals from tested properties, not from a poster name.

concepts.name: Density
concepts.summary: Density as a measured property used in identification.

concepts.name: Igneous cooling
concepts.summary: Cooling history recorded in igneous texture and related evidence.

concepts.name: Sedimentary environment
concepts.summary: Formation environment written in sedimentary materials.

concepts.name: Metamorphic parent
concepts.summary: Parent rock and conditions implied by metamorphic evidence.

concepts.name: Rock transformation
concepts.summary: Material evidence of how one rock became another.

concepts.name: Porosity and permeability
concepts.summary: How pore space and connectedness affect fluids in rock.

concepts.name: Competing identification
concepts.summary: Tell an economic mineral from a lookalike using tests, not wishful naming.

concepts.name: Ice and water as agents
concepts.summary: Ice versus water as agents that reshape slopes.

concepts.name: Glacial landforms
concepts.summary: Landforms and deposits that record moving ice.

concepts.name: Weathering
concepts.summary: Ways rock breaks down at the surface.

concepts.name: Soil profile
concepts.summary: Soil as a record of weathering and time on a slope.

concepts.name: Mass wasting
concepts.summary: Downslope movement of rock and soil under gravity.

concepts.name: Source to sink
concepts.summary: Sediment from source through transport to deposition.

concepts.name: Drainage pattern
concepts.summary: How stream networks organize a landscape.

concepts.name: Landscape clocks
concepts.summary: Different processes need different lengths of time.

concepts.name: Hollow transfer
concepts.summary: Reuse Cedar Hollow runoff and slope notes in later surface-process work without reteaching Topic 1.

concepts.name: Seismic interior
concepts.summary: Infer interior structure from seismic evidence you cannot walk into.

concepts.name: Fault offset
concepts.summary: Offset land as evidence of fault motion.

concepts.name: Volcanic products
concepts.summary: What a volcano leaves on the surface and what that implies underneath.

concepts.name: Geothermal path
concepts.summary: Heat and fluid paths from depth to hot springs or related features.

concepts.name: Plate motion
concepts.summary: Plate motion inferred from surface clues.

concepts.name: Plate-boundary geometry
concepts.summary: Boundary type and geometry from field and map evidence.

concepts.name: Lahar siting
concepts.summary: Where volcanic mudflows can travel, used as a siting problem.

concepts.name: Convection model
concepts.summary: A model of interior convection constrained by surface evidence.

concepts.name: Superposition and way-up
concepts.summary: Which bed is older, and which way was originally up.

concepts.name: Cross-cutting relationships
concepts.summary: A feature that cuts another is younger than what it cuts.

concepts.name: Unconformity
concepts.summary: A gap in the rock record you can point to.

concepts.name: Stratigraphic correlation
concepts.summary: Matching rock units across a canyon or region. Not the Topic 1 habit of confusing togetherness with cause.

concepts.name: Index fossil
concepts.summary: Fossils used to correlate and constrain relative age.

concepts.name: Radiometric age
concepts.summary: Numerical age from radiometric evidence, checked against other lines.

concepts.name: Conflicting ages
concepts.summary: What to do when dating lines disagree.

concepts.name: Multi-line history
concepts.summary: Reconstruct events from several independent lines of evidence.

concepts.name: Fault age transfer
concepts.summary: Use earlier fault evidence when reading a later stratigraphic story.

concepts.name: Water budget
concepts.summary: Where water is stored and how it moves among reservoirs.

concepts.name: Infiltration vs runoff
concepts.summary: Water that soaks in versus water that runs off.

concepts.name: Groundwater
concepts.summary: Water stored and moving in the ground.

concepts.name: Estuary mixing
concepts.summary: Where fresh and salt water mix along a working shore.

concepts.name: Tides
concepts.summary: Tidal period and range, including Earth–Moon–Sun geometry without reteaching Topic 10.

concepts.name: Currents
concepts.summary: Ocean and coastal currents as movers of water and sediment.

concepts.name: Longshore transport
concepts.summary: Sediment moving along a shore.

concepts.name: Tsunami safety
concepts.summary: Scientifically appropriate response when a tsunami hazard is real.

concepts.name: Watershed coupling
concepts.summary: Land, groundwater, and coast as one coupled water system.

concepts.name: Station observations
concepts.summary: Read the atmosphere from real station observations.

concepts.name: Pressure and wind
concepts.summary: How pressure patterns relate to wind.

concepts.name: Fronts
concepts.summary: Boundaries between air masses as observed change.

concepts.name: Dew point
concepts.summary: Moisture in the air as a measured quantity, not a slogan.

concepts.name: Forecast
concepts.summary: A short-range forecast from changing observations.

concepts.name: Severe weather recognition
concepts.summary: Recognize hazardous weather from evidence, then choose a safe response.

concepts.name: Hurricane place
concepts.summary: Where a hurricane's hazards actually sit relative to the person.

concepts.name: Lightning safety
concepts.summary: A scientifically appropriate lightning response.

concepts.name: Forecast revision
concepts.summary: Change a forecast when later observations disagree.

concepts.name: Weather vs climate
concepts.summary: Separate a hot day from a long record.

concepts.name: Long climate record
concepts.summary: What a long record can say that a single cold day cannot.

concepts.name: Energy budget
concepts.summary: Energy balance and flows that climate explanations must respect.

concepts.name: Ice-albedo feedback
concepts.summary: Ice, reflectivity, and feedbacks in a long record.

concepts.name: Local change and scale
concepts.summary: Local change read at the scale the evidence actually supports.

concepts.name: Greenhouse and reservoirs
concepts.summary: Greenhouse gases and carbon/heat reservoirs as evidenced stores, not slogans.

concepts.name: Ranged forecast
concepts.summary: Forecast a consequence with uncertainty named honestly.

concepts.name: Weather/climate sort
concepts.summary: Sort claims into weather versus climate before arguing causes.

concepts.name: Water-source synthesis
concepts.summary: Use the whole water toolkit in a community decision.

concepts.name: Landslide mitigation
concepts.summary: A defensible response to slope failure using earlier map and surface-process work.

concepts.name: Mine and water tradeoff
concepts.summary: Resource extraction versus water quality as a coupled decision.

concepts.name: Fire-weather route
concepts.summary: A route choice under fire weather using spatial and atmospheric evidence.

concepts.name: Dam and fault
concepts.summary: Infrastructure sitting on geologic hazard as a synthesis problem.

concepts.name: Winter route
concepts.summary: A winter travel or siting choice that needs weather, terrain, and earlier habits.

concepts.name: Drought allocation
concepts.summary: Allocate scarce water using budget and long-record evidence.

concepts.name: Whole toolkit
concepts.summary: A sustainability decision that requires tools and understanding from earlier topics — not a new isolated unit.
